**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the **active** voice and '**Ram**' is the subject and '**Sita**' is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into **passive** voice, the subject 'Sita' of the **active** voice becomes the object, the object '**Ram**' becomes the subject.
 
• The active format "**V₁**" should be converted into the passive format "**is/are** + V₂".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the **present indefinite** tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Find the resistance (in mega Ω) of a wire of length 20 m, cross sectional area 1 cm² and made of a material of resistivity 200 Ωm.
questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**__:

__
 
• Resistance: The property of any conductor that opposes the flow of electric current through it and depends on the shape and size of the materials, temperature, and nature of the materials is called resistance.

 
 
• It is denoted by R and the SI unit is the ohm (Ω).
 
 

The resistance is given by:

R = ρL/A

where ρ is resistivity, L is the length and A is the area of the cross-section. 

**CALCULATION**__:

Given that:

Length (L) = 20 m

The cross-sectional area (A) = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m²

The Resistivity (ρ) = 200 Ω m

We know that,

Resistance (R) = Resistivity (ρ) × (Length(L)/Cross sectional area (A))

Now,

R = [200 × (20/0.0001)] = 4 × 10⁷ Ω = 4 × 10⁷ × 10⁻⁶ mega Ω 

**R = 40 mega Ω. So option 1 is correct**
